attempts.rationale: I want to test a robust weighted approach that can adapt to the unstable ranking and correlated errors; softmax_neg_error on the full pool should downweight the top error models.
Test a simple mean over the full model pool to see if a non‑weighted average can beat the current weighted softmax combination, probing robustness given the unstable ranking.
test a robust weighted combination over the full pool using softmax_neg_error to address unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
Test a median combination on the full pool to see if a robust non‑parametric aggregator improves over weighted softmax.
Test a robust DBA combination on the full pool, leveraging the high predictability and strong seasonality while mitigating ranking instability.
Test a trimmed mean on the full pool to see if trimming outliers improves over weighted softmax, given strong seasonality and trend.
I want to test a weighted combination that uses inverse_error weights on the full pool, to see if a simpler inverse‑error weighting beats the softmax variant already tried.
Test a weighted combination on the small pool1 using the w1 weight to see if a more focused softmax over a few strong models improves over the full‑pool weighted w2.

I want to see if a weighted combination limited to pool1 with inverse_error weights can beat the current leader, given pool1 contains strong models (THETA, rf, catboost, CWT_rf, ONLY_DWT_rf) and inverse_error may emphasize the best of them.
test a weighted combination on the full pool using the w1 weight scheme to see if a different weighting improves over inverse_error and softmax_neg_error.
Test a weighted combination over pool1 using softmax_neg_error to see if a softer weighting improves robustness given high trend/seasonality and unstable rankings.
Try a dba (dynamic Bayesian aggregation) on pool1 to see if a more adaptive weighting improves over weighted/trimmed means, given the strong trend and seasonality.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8322. Series context: trend strength 0.8243 and seasonal strength 0.8698; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.275); 8 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.187.
